blocks.text: CITY OF MALOLOS — Water elevation at Angat Dam has dropped by more than a meter in 11 days, from 208.88 meters above sea level in the last week of September to 207.84 masl on Thursday, Oct. 8, according to data from the Bulacan Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction Management Office. The decline comes as the government prepares for the worst impacts of this year’s El Niño. The 208.88 masl record on Sept. 27 was the highest elevation reached at the Angat reservoir following weeks of rain brought by strong typhoons Luis and Maymay, other tropical depressions, and the southwest monsoon from […]...
